04/Dated: 15.05.2024
The petitioner, who is accused for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 504, 506 of the Ipc, is
praying for grant of regular bail, as he is in custody since 04.02.2024.
Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
The same is kept on record with sealed cover.
After perusing the FIR, I find that the victim stated that on the pretext of marriage sexual relationship was established, thereafter he refused to marry with her.
As per the victim, the incident had occurred on 8th October, 2023 to 22 October, 2023.

The Sessions Judge has stated in the impugned order that in paragraph 47 of the case dairy the date of birth of the prosecutrix is 23.8.2005, thus on the date of occurrence as per the FIR which starts from 8th October, 2023 to 22nd October, 2023 victim is major and more than 18 years old.
Learned APP opposes the prayer for bail.
Considering the allegation and the fact that petitioner is in custody since 04.02.2024, I am inclined to allow this application.

Accordingly, the petitioner above named is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Judicial Magistrate, Hazaribagh in connection with Tatijharia P.S.
Case No. 46 of 2023.
